sentences: The model scored case #123 at 0.964, 11th of the 250 returns of model_valid, where a return with average values scores about 0.01. The two largest reasons were its large other income, 28,500 against an average of 7,584, and its large deduction, 42,000 against 19,453; its low tax for its income came third, and all three pushed the score up.
